name: Akiris by the Bundle
summary: In Booty Bay, Privateer Bloads seeks akiris reeds for an associate who pays well. The naga were last seen on the northern beach, where you must take the reeds from them.

sections.title: A Profitable Ocean Plant
sections.body: Privateer Bloads offers seaside work in Booty Bay. His associate Groy pays well for bundles of akiris reed, a plant that grows by the sea and bears the name the naga give it. Bloads does not know why Groy wants the reeds. He needs ten stalks, and the naga were last seen on the northern beach.

aliases: who gives akiris by the bundle
faq.answer: Privateer Bloads is a privateer in Booty Bay who offers work to those who ask.
Akiris reed is a valuable ocean plant that the naga call by that name. Privateer Bloads does not know its purpose, but collectors pay well for bundles of stalks.

faq.q: Where can the naga holding the reeds be found?
faq.answer: The naga with the stalks prowl the coastline north of Booty Bay, along the beaches of Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Who buys the reeds from Privateer Bloads?
faq.answer: Bloads gathers the bundles for an associate named Groy, who earns a substantial profit by selling the ocean reeds.
